topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 73 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 1 ERC20 token, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 7 common project-authored base contract(s) (basestrategy, sturdyleverage, baseleverage). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
